activity.notes: Brutus was not a ruler of the Roman Republic. In 44 BCE he was urban praetor and one of the principal conspirators against Julius Caesar; after the assassination he became a leading commander of the republican cause in the civil war, ending with his defeat and death after Philippi in 42 BCE. ATLAS therefore uses active_in rather than rules.

sources.title: 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica — Brutus
sources.citation_text: The reference identifies Marcus Junius Brutus as city praetor in 44 BCE, a leading participant in Caesar's assassination, and a defender of the republican cause until his defeat and death in 42 BCE.
